decision: Selected the ITM site reference that the Art Data Centres Ennis Campus EIAR (Chapter 11, AWN Consulting) gives for the proposed data centre development at Tooreen and Cahernalough, Ennis (ITM 537485/679651), transformed to WGS84, as the campus locator replacing the imported Ennis town point.
source_location: PDF page 75 of '314474 - eiar 9.0 noise & vibration 1.pdf' (the file's text layer also carries Chapters 10 and 11): 'Chapter 11 - Archaeological, Architectural and Cultural Heritage', section 11.1.1: '... a proposed data centre development at Tooreen and Cahernalough, Ennis, County Clare (ITM 537485/679651; Figure 11.1)'; footer 'ART DATA CENTRE ENNIS CAMPUS EIAR'

facts.transformation: pyproj 3.7.1 EPSG:2157 -> EPSG:4326 (always_xy), rounded to 7 decimals

corroboration: An Coimisiún Pleanála's inspector's report on ABP-314474-22 places the c.60 ha appeal site in the townlands of Toureen and Cahernalough, c.4 km NE of Ennis, east of the M18 and the Junction 13 slip road, north of the R352 (Tulla Road) and south of the L4608; the selected point is 4.0 km from the Ennis town point. An earlier research lane (ie-pleanala-p3) read the national planning register point for Clare 21757 as 52.8636449, -8.9295865, 95 m from the selected point; that register service is not used here because its host now serves an access-controlled robots.txt.
exclusions: The EIAR does not say how the site reference was chosen or how accurate it is; it is taken as a point locating the campus site as a whole, not a building, the substation or the application boundary. No map service, geocoder or town centre is used.
